name: comp-301
title: Cookie Consent Banner
description: A dark, wide bar that explains the site's cookie use and offers Accept and Decline buttons. The buttons sit inline beside the text on wide screens and wrap under it on narrow ones.
use: Visitors must accept or decline tracking before they continue on a site.
avoid: The demo buttons have no click handlers, so dismissal and saved choice must be wired yourself.
a11y: The bar has no role or live region, so screen readers are not told a consent notice appeared; the buttons do carry visible text. (keyboard: yes, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A thin near-black bar with a one-pixel border and softly rounded corners spans most of the stage. Small light-grey text sits on the left; on the right a filled white Accept button and an outlined Decline button sit side by side.
behaves: At rest, nothing moves: a fixed message with two buttons. The clip only shows the cursor drifting across them, and no click handler is wired in the source.
customise: The message and both button labels are written in the file; colours and spacing come from theme and shared button classes.
weight: light: A thin static bar with two buttons; no script, no animation.
